clarifications.api_delivery_normalization: If the official MEXC public read-only API fallback is used, its bar close-time field is not relied upon; each accepted 1D bar is normalized to [open_time, open, high, low, close, volume] with canonical UTC day close=open_time+86400000-1.
clarifications.equivalence_tolerance: numeric equality at <=1e-12 relative/absolute tolerance after decimal-to-float normalization
clarifications.oos_start_position_state: FLAT_PER_SYMBOL_AT_2025-01-01; pre-2025 signals are warmup-only and do not create carry-in positions.
clarifications.right_censoring: An OOS signal is eligible only if entry_open_time + 40*DAY_MS < 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z; later signals are recorded as right-censored and do not affect overlap state or economics.
